card.name: Partway through names of people and brands
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a piece in the middle or end of a proper name. These are romanized Chinese names (Tam, Xin, Xing) and invented drug brand names (Unituxin, VYKAT XR, GLYXAMBI).

modes.label: Chinese names
modes.description: Syllables of romanized Chinese place or person names, often before the rest of the name.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: The closing or middle piece of a capitalized brand name in a drug label.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese characters and odd name pieces, so it hints at continuing a name or Chinese text.
card.plain: It fires inside a name that is split into parts, such as a Chinese name or a brand drug name.
